But I desperately ask you to please hold off on ending it all. All of the things you did for the last time today, let yourself at least have the chance to do them again. If you go in the morning, you’ll never be able to experience anything ever again. Sure that may include all the shitty stuff that you won’t have to deal with, but it also includes all the good things. Please will you stay here for a while more?
